title: Unterdruckgreifer zum Ergreifen, Anheben und Transportieren von Bechern

features.item: A housing with a grip portion for gripping and an electrically operated vacuum generating device
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes a vacuum gripper (Unterdruckgreifer) for gripping, lifting, and transporting cups, which includes a section (Abschnitt) that extends in a longitudinal direction, implying a housing with a grip portion. It also mentions a vacuum line (Unterdruckleitung) connected to a vacuum source (Unterdruckquelle), indicating a vacuum generating device.

features.item: The grip portion is a hollow body
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 10) The reference mentions a tubular body (rohrförmigen Körper) through which the vacuum line runs, which is a hollow structure. However, it specifically refers to the 'tubular body' and not explicitly the 'grip portion' as a hollow body, although the tubular body could be part of the grip portion.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device is guided through the grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum line for suction but does not mention the routing of exhaust air or an air outlet.

features.item: A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not disclose any sound-damping device.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip portion
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 10) The reference describes a vacuum gripper with a tubular body and a vacuum line, which implies a grip unit and vacuum generation. However, it does not mention exhaust air routing through the grip or a sound-damping device.

features.item: A vacuum handling apparatus comprising a suction plate with carrier plate and seal, and a grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes a vacuum gripper with a suction body (Saugkörper) that forms a sealing connection with the cup, and a vacuum line. This implies a suction interface and a grip unit with vacuum generation. However, it lacks details about a carrier plate, exhaust air routing through the grip, and a sound-damping device.

features.item: The grip portion is at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not disclose any lining with sound-damping material in the grip portion.

features.item: The vacuum generating device is arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: The reference mentions a vacuum line and a vacuum source but does not describe the physical arrangement of a vacuum generating device within specific housing portions.

features.item: A sound-reducing device is arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not disclose any sound-reducing device or lining in any housing portion.

features.item: The grip portion is elongated between the first housing portion and a second housing portion, with air outlet on the second housing portion
features.note: The reference describes an elongated section and a tubular body, but it does not define distinct first and second housing portions with an air outlet on the second portion.

features.item: An air collection screw arranged upstream of the grip portion in the first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not disclose an air collection screw or any specific mechanism for collecting exhaust air.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of the grip portion for guiding exhaust air to the air outlet
features.note: The reference does not disclose any air baffles or a mechanism for guiding exhaust air.

features.item: A battery coupling point on the second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from the battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not mention a battery coupling point or air baffles for directing exhaust air away from it.

features.item: The grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference does not describe a releasable connection between a grip unit and a suction plate.

features.item: The grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference states that a suction opening (Ansaugöffnung) is formed in the suction body (Saugkörper) and is connected to a vacuum line (Unterdruckleitung). It also mentions that the suction body forms a vacuum space (Unterdruckraum) which is flow-connected to the suction opening.

claims.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper for cups, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device with a suction plate.

The reference describes a vacuum gripper for cups, but does not mention a grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions, nor an air outlet on a second housing portion.
The reference describes a vacuum gripper for cups, but does not mention an air collection device or an air collection screw for collecting exhaust air.
The reference describes a vacuum gripper for cups, but does not mention air baffles for guiding exhaust air.
The reference describes a vacuum gripper for cups, but does not mention a battery coupling point or an electrical energy storage device.
The reference describes a vacuum gripper for cups and does not mention air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.
(non-English passage at abstract) The reference discloses a vacuum gripper for gripping, lifting, and transporting cups, which is a type of vacuum handling apparatus.

(non-English passage at claim 8) The reference discloses a suction body with an annular sealing lip for a sealing connection, which is a type of seal. However, it does not explicitly mention a carrier plate to which the seal is fastened and extends around.
This claim refers to 'claim 1' of the subject invention, which is not provided in the reference text. Therefore, it cannot be assessed.

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum gripper with a suction body, a displaceable ring element with restoring means, and various structural details that align well with many of the subject claims.
